text: nail's `-S` seed filter on loss-decomp's MGnify unit at 48 threads: 1e-4, the default, takes 449 s at sensitivity 0.9045; 1e-3 takes 744 s at 0.9137; 1e-2 takes 2,928 s at 0.9184.
